Subject: Tamsin 2027 rate
Body: Hi Tobias, for the Petrel pricing review: the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Tamsin Cold Chain is $2,274 a seat. I got it from my call with them yesterday and it isn't in any document yet. Thanks, Dana

One catch: the mail tool saves drafts in the mailbox of the person asking, so it's in your drafts, not Dana's. You can send it from there, or Dana can ask me in #north-random and I'll save a copy in her mailbox so she can send it herself, as she wanted.

I saved Dana's Tamsin Cold Chain draft and replied to June in her DM. Nothing has been sent.

- **The draft:** It's addressed to Tobias Rendle (trendle@pemberline.com) with the subject "Tamsin 2027 rate". The body is the text Dana asked for in #north-random on Oct 14: the proposed 2027 rate of $2,274 a seat, for the Petrel pricing review.
- **Approval:** June can approve this herself, so the $2,274 figure is cleared to go to Tobias. Tobias has an internal address, so Ruth doesn't need to approve it.
- **Wrong mailbox:** Dana wanted the draft in her mailbox so she could send it herself. But the mail tool only saves drafts to the person asking, so it went into June's drafts. I told June she can send it from there, or Dana can ask me in #north-random and I'll save a copy in Dana's drafts.

I didn't tell Dana in #north-random, because June's approval came in a private DM and I don't pass DM content into a channel.
